scope: 113 missing CPU IDs from final-coverage.json at start of supplement pass; existing main and extra manifests preserved
notes: This is a bounded public-source research pass; unresolved means no exact photo was verified in the sources reviewed, not that no image exists.

Every assigned ID has a dedicated Commons category attempt; 25 prior second-pass category results were reused rather than needlessly requested again. Additional family and exact part-number categories were checked for historical CPUs.
HTTP 403 is a transport/access block; HTTP 404 is a missing source URL/category. Neither is treated as image absence. Exact retailer listings with generic media were rejected after visual inspection.

On HTTP 429, the requesting host batch stopped. Early Retry-After values were 1 second; later category and original-source responses specified 1000 and 600 seconds respectively. Early batches resumed only after extended backoff; no further host requests were made after the longer limits. The rate-limited source URLs themselves were not retried.

Accepted sourceSha256 hashes the exact raw provider bytes used for local derivation, either original files or cached licensed provider previews as declared by sourceHashScope. imageUrl identifies those bytes; originalImageUrl remains separate. sha256 and thumbnailSha256 hash the final reviewed WebP assets.
Retailer media reviewed here are not asserted to be openly licensed or manufacturer-owned; no retailer image was accepted in this increment.
